Maths, Biology & Chemistry Tuition Helping students excel in O, A-Level & IB exams. Clear concepts. Smart strategies. Proven results. Sign Up

Why EZATuition?

At EZA, I place{" "} my students at the center of everything I do — every lesson, resource, and approach is tailored to meet their unique needs. With over 7 years of tutoring experience {" "} in Biology, Chemistry, and Math across the{" "} O-Level, A-Level, and IB syllabi , I’ve helped students not only improve their grades but also gain the confidence to tackle challenging questions independently.

What sets EZA apart is a flexible hybrid model to suit diverse learning preferences:{" "} small group Zoom sessions (max 5 students) {" "} to ensure interaction and engagement, and one-on-one in-person lessons for highly customized support. As a tutor, I bring the qualities that matter most: patience and empathy to guide students at their own pace, clarity and structure to break down complex topics simply, adaptability to adjust methods to different learning styles, responsiveness to provide timely help and feedback, and{" "} reliability and consistency to ensure steady progress over time.

Resource Library

To support student success, I've established a robust academic resource platform, including a Google Drive and a Telegram channel. The Google Drive serves as a central repository for essential learning materials, such as detailed class notes, practice homework with solutions, and a curated archive of past year papers with comprehensive solutions. Complementing this, the exclusive Telegram channel actively addresses student needs by sharing insights on commonly encountered questions and common errors, thereby proactively guiding students to avoid pitfalls and deepen their understanding.

To ensure all students feel comfortable participating, our Zoom classes incorporate an interactive Poll Everywhere platform, enabling all students to anonymously submit questions throughout the session without hesitation.
